speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment of the breast mass, could you please tell me your age and describe how you first noticed the lump?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Does the mass feel hard and fixed in place, or is it soft and movable? Have you noticed any skin changes like dimpling, redness, or nipple discharge?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass.

speaker: Doctor
text: A rapidly enlarging mass without skin changes or pain in a 48-year-old woman raises concern for a phyllodes tumor or high-grade carcinoma. I will order imaging to characterize the lesion further. REQUEST TEST: Breast_Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text: A normal ultrasound is highly unusual for a palpable, rapidly enlarging mass, so I need to clarify if a physical exam was also performed. Have you undergone a clinical breast exam by a physician, and were any axillary lymph nodes found to be enlarged?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical or surgical history. No family history of breast cancer. Social history: Non-smoker, moderate alcohol use. Elementary school teacher.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal ultrasound result is conflicting with the clinical presentation of a rapidly enlarging mass, so I must proceed with more definitive imaging. REQUEST TEST: Breast_Mammogram

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Mammography Findings: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast.

speaker: Doctor
text: The mammogram showing a smooth polylobulated mass in the context of rapid growth strongly suggests a phyllodes tumor rather than typical carcinoma. To confirm this distinction and assess the tissue architecture, I need a definitive sample. REQUEST TEST: Core_Needle_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Biopsy Microscopic Description: Image shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy showing leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth is pathognomonic for a phyllodes tumor. DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor
